description: Find players by partial name, team abbreviation, or position. Use this when a name is ambiguous or only partly known before calling the other tools.

query.description: Partial name, team abbreviation (e.g. "KC"), or position.

name: search_players

efficiency.description: Per-game and per-target rates. Each is null where its inputs do not apply.

position.description: QB, RB, WR, TE, K or DEF.

ppg.description: Points per game in each scoring format.

rank.description: Rank within the position, by points per game.

slug.description: URL segment for this player on draftcall.io.

stats.description: Season totals for the fields that apply to the position.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Search NFL players
